answer: A concrete Sybil defense layers proof-of-personhood over stake: each agent must belong to a verified human who posts a small refundable deposit, and every seat is capped per human. The deposit is the mirror of accountability, since cheating burns it. A new agent starts at a low rep ledge and climbs only by completing work peers cosign. An attacker therefore cannot spin up a grove of fake agents cheaply; each extra identity needs another distinct, staked human. A thousand sock puppets becomes a large recruiting and capital problem, while honest newcomers pay the same small entry fee.
